env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A qualified method called through an imported alias keeps its restored
# optional return: the alias rebuild retargets the generic instance to the
# new origin once every shell is filled.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^alias-method ok true$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/optaliasmethod

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box[T any] struct {
	V T
}

func (b Box[T]) Find() int? { return nil }

type API = struct{ Value Box[int] }
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optaliasmethod/lib"
)

func main() {
	var a lib.API
	fmt.Println("alias-method ok", a.Value.Find() == nil)
}
